# Anogeissus

> Professional photography tools for Mac, iPad, and iPhone.

Anogeissus builds software for photographers. Our products include ApolloOne (the fastest image viewer on the planet, now with full HDR support), ApolloOne GO (a RAW viewer and culling tool for iPad and iPhone), and Camera RawX (Quick Look and Finder thumbnails for unsupported RAW files using the RawBridge™ engine, with HDR Quick Look on EDR-capable Macs).

## Products

- [ApolloOne](https://anogeissus.com/apolloone.html): The fastest photo and video viewer for macOS, with full HDR support. Version 5 adds tabs and windows, List View, Stacks, Focus Score (grades how sharply the camera focused, at its own AF points and on faces), AI Keywords and AI Rating (Apple Private Cloud Compute), ML Processing (Apple's machine learning RAW decoder with noise reduction), hierarchical keywords, a customizable status bar and AppleScript automation. Also: browse at up to 32 fps, full-resolution HDR RAW viewing, AF point display, EXIF and metadata editing, GPS maps with Street View, Quick Edit for non-destructive adjustments, HDR Visualizer, and HDR export to AVIF, JPEG XL, gain-map JPEG/HEIC and OpenEXR. Available as Free, Standard, Pro and Max editions; every installation starts with a 14-day Max Edition free trial and falls back to the Free Edition afterwards. Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
- [ApolloOne GO](https://anogeissus.com/apolloone-go.html): A fast RAW viewer and culling tool for iPad and iPhone, on the App Store. Browse folders, drives, and SD cards in place through the Files app, or connect the camera itself over USB-C and browse it directly (embedded JPEG previews) and import only your picks. Full-resolution RAW viewing with HDR display and AF point overlays, thumb-friendly Pick/Reject culling, contact sheet with batch operations, and AirDrop export. Culling decisions are written as standard Finder color tags that sync through iCloud, so ApolloOne on the Mac picks them up automatically. Powered by the RawBridge™ engine. Shows every camera RAW, and since version 1.1.0 any JPEG or HEIC/HEIF that has no RAW of the same name beside it, so JPEG-only shots such as pre-release capture bursts can be culled too; TIFF, PNG and GIF are not shown. A RAW+JPEG pair is listed once, as the RAW, so the Pick/Reject decision lands on the RAW rather than on a JPEG copy. Those decisions are standard Finder color tags, which are file metadata: the RAW files themselves are never modified. Contact sheet filters for All, Picked, Picked + Unmarked and Rejected, with photos grouped by capture day. On a memory card or SSD, Delete moves files into a Rejected folder instead of erasing them. Free to download with a 14-day free trial; one-time purchase to unlock, no subscription. Requires iPadOS or iOS 16 or later.
- [Camera RawX](https://anogeissus.com/camerarawx.html): A macOS extension that adds Quick Look previews and Finder thumbnails for camera RAW files that macOS doesn't support natively, with HDR Quick Look on EDR-capable Macs. Powered by the RawBridge™ engine. Supports Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, Sony, Olympus, Panasonic, Samsung, Sigma Foveon, and Adobe DNG.
- [KatClaw](https://katclaw.ai): The native macOS companion for OpenClaw. AI automation with security-first design.
